Container.Name: Atlas
Container.Overview: Atlas is a self-hosted Usenet indexer with a Newznab-compatible API. This package builds the unmodified upstream Dockerfile.
Container.Requires: An NNTP/Usenet provider account. SABnzbd is optional but required for direct downloads.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Atlas configuration, SQLite database, logs, cache, and generated data.

Config.Name: SABnzbd Config
Config.Description: SABnzbd configuration directory. Atlas reads the SABnzbd API key from sabnzbd.ini and uses its watched folder.

Config.Name: Newznab API Port
Config.Description: Atlas Newznab API host port; container listens on 9090.

Config.Name: Index Mode
Config.Description: Indexing mode: dynamic, live, or backfill.

Config.Name: Ollama Host
Config.Description: Ollama API URL for AI Search, for example http://192.168.1.10:11434. Ollama must have the qwen3:4b model installed.

Config.Name: SABnzbd Host
Config.Description: SABnzbd container name or server IP.
